selection_policy: Use 11 complete tasks from the local 220-cell root, 7 disjoint locally owned complete tasks from the additional root, and 10 collaborator-complete tasks. Compare overlapping local cells but retain collaborator aggregates for collaborator-owned tasks. Exclude quarantine.
design: 28 tasks x {opus, sonnet} x {no-skill, with-skill} x trials 1-5

bootstrap.unit: task; average model means within task

key_f1_definition: 2 * (agent_unique_keys - extra_keys) / (agent_unique_keys + reference_rows), with reference_rows from tables/task_details.tex; reconstructed from retained evaluator counts, not a fresh evaluation of output CSVs

harness_indicators.cli_versions: Claude Code versions observed in trace.jsonl
harness_indicators.recorded_model_overrides: model-slot environment overrides recorded in result.json; null means no override was recorded and Claude Code native routing applied
harness_indicators.assistant_models: assistant models observed in trace events; native routing can add claude-haiku-4-5 calls to requested Opus/Sonnet runs
